title: On the stability of acid-soluble pea protein-stabilized beverage emulsions against salt addition and heat treatment
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18430-18443
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06899H, Paper
Open Access

Maryam Nikbakht Nasrabadi, Michael N. A. Eskin, Usha Thiyam-Hollander, Supratim Ghosh
This study explores the use of an acidic water-soluble fraction of pea protein as an effective plant-based emulsifier for developing low-pH oil-in-water emulsions stable to thermal treatment.
